name: CMU Scenario-based Database for Connected and Autonomous Driving in a Smart City
license: No public dataset license or downloadable archive located on the official project page.
citation: Zhao, D. A Scenario-based Database for Connected and Autonomous Driving in A Smart City, CMU Traffic21 project #275, 2019.
download_size: Not applicable; public project reports are available, but no scenario-data archive is published.
required_credentials: Restricted/unknown. Contact project PI Ding Zhao at dingzhao@cmu.edu for dataset availability and terms.
geographic_coverage: Pittsburgh; planned heterogeneous capture included lidar, camera, radar, GPS, IMU, vehicle controls, and smart-city signals/weather/events.
pittsburgh_coverage: Project-specific Pittsburgh coverage was proposed; exact released coverage is not public.
summary: The public project record and reports describe a planned scenario library, not a downloadable data release. It may be highly relevant to interaction-scenario calibration, but must not be represented as public data.
notes: Record papers/project materials only. Do not scrape traffic-net.org or restricted CMU systems.
